TOONCAT SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURES
Supplementary figures, in order of reference, for the toonCat manuscript. Includes only the R generated plots, but other figures are noted. See MATLAB scripts and figures folder for other figure components.

```{r Setup, warning=F, message=F, echo=FALSE}
# Setup file
source("~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/code/toonCat_analysisSetup.R")

# Set global variables
output_directory <- "~/Documents/projects/toonCat/analysis/results/supplementary/figures/"
LMM_filters <- c("hemi != 'mh'", "hemi != 'zh'", "ROI != 'blank'","ROI != 'blank1'", "category != 'word'", "category != 'words'")
ventralLMM_filters <- c("hemi != 'mh'", "hemi != 'zh'", "ROI != 'blank'","ROI != 'blank1'", "stream == 'ventral'")
retinotopyLMM_filters <- c("ROI %in% c('V1', 'V2', 'V3')", "hemi != 'mh'", "hemi != 'zh'")
```

# Supplementary Figure 1. Category-selective regions are modulated by the Toonotopy experiment. 
A: Category localizer stimuli
B: Proportion of voxels with > 20% VE
```{r 2C - Proprotion of voxels with > 20% variance explained, fig.width=12, fig.height=4, warning=F, message=F, echo=FALSE}
png(file.path(output_directory, "S.Figure1_prop20ve.png"), units="in", width=15, height=2.25, res=300)

roi_order_all <- c("pOTS_words","mOTS_words","OTS_bodies",
                   "IOG_faces","pFus_faces","mFus_faces",
                   "CoS_places","blank","LOS_limbs","ITG_limbs",
                   "MTG_limbs","pSTS_faces","blank1","MOG_places","IPS_places")

pal <- c(
  pOTS_words="#000066", mOTS_words="#000066", OTS_bodies="#E4CD04",
  IOG_faces="#FF0000",  pFus_faces="#FF0000", mFus_faces="#FF0000",
  CoS_places="#008000", blank="#FFFFFF",
  LOS_limbs="#E4CD04",  ITG_limbs="#E4CD04", MTG_limbs="#E4CD04",
  pSTS_faces="#FF0000", blank1="#FFFFFF",
  MOG_places="#008000", IPS_places="#008000"
)

df.CoV %>%
  mutate(ROI   = factor(stringr::str_trim(as.character(ROI)), levels = roi_order_all)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = interaction(group, hemi, sep = "."), 
                y = proportion20, 
                color = ROI, 
                fill = ROI, 
                alpha = hemi)) +
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean,
               geom = "pointrange", 
               color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, 
               geom = "errorbar", 
               color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(y = "Proportion Voxels \n with >20% VE") +
  facet_grid(~ ROI) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=16),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "null"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray96",size = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        text = element_text(family = "Avenir")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, na.translate = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("lh" = 0.45, "rh" = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, na.translate = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, .25), limits = c(-.25,1.25)) 
dev.off()
```

# Supplementary Figure 9. Visual field coverage (VFC) of category-selective ROIs develop differentially - left hemisphere. 
A: Average VFC
B: Total FWHM by ROI
```{r}
png(file.path(output_directory, "S.Figure9_totalFWHM_violin_lh.png"), units = "in", width = 15, height = 3, res = 300)

roi_order_lh <- c("pOTS_words","mOTS_words","OTS_bodies",
                  "IOG_faces","pFus_faces","mFus_faces",
                  "CoS_places","blank","LOS_limbs","ITG_limbs",
                  "MTG_limbs","pSTS_faces","blank1","MOG_places","IPS_places")

df.plot <- df.CoV_cat_latdors %>%
  mutate(
    ROI   = factor(stringr::str_trim(as.character(ROI)), levels = roi_order_lh),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("adolescents","Adults")),
    hemi  = factor(hemi,  levels = c("lh","rh","zh")),
    category = case_when(
      grepl("_faces$",  ROI)                         ~ "faces",
      grepl("_words$",  ROI)                         ~ "words",
      grepl("_places$", ROI)                         ~ "places",
      grepl("(_bodies$|_limbs$|^OTS_bodies$)", ROI)  ~ "bodies",
      ROI %in% c("blank","blank1")                  ~ "blank",
      TRUE                                           ~ "other"
    ),
    fill_key  = interaction(category, group, sep = "."),
    # Adults color per category for points (used below)
    point_col = case_when(
      category == "faces"  ~ "#8B0000",
      category == "bodies" ~ "#BA8E23",
      category == "places" ~ "#013220",
      category == "words"  ~ "#000066",
      TRUE                 ~ "#7f7f7f"
    )
  )

# ------- 2) Fill palette to match bar colors -------
fill_pal <- c(
  "faces.adolescents"   = "#FF0000",
  "faces.Adults"        = "#8B0000",
  "bodies.adolescents"  = "#E4CD04",
  "bodies.Adults"       = "#BA8E23",
  "places.adolescents"  = "#008000",
  "places.Adults"       = "#013220",
  "words.adolescents"   = "#0000FF",
  "words.Adults"        = "#000066",
  "blank.adolescents"   = "#FFFFFF",
  "blank.Adults"        = "#FFFFFF"
)

perform_and_save_t_tests <- function(data, split_var, group_var, measure_var, output_file_base) {
  # 1) Filter & split by hemisphere × ROI
  data_filtered <- data %>%
    filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
           !(ROI %in% c("blank","blank1","blank2","blank3","blank4"))) %>%
    na.omit()

  split_data <- split(data_filtered, list(data_filtered$hemi, data_filtered$ROI))

  # 2) Per-split Welch t-test (adolescents vs Adults)
  perform_t_test <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    group_data <- df %>% filter(!!sym(group_var) == "adolescents") %>% pull(!!sym(measure_var))
    adult_data <- df %>% filter(!!sym(group_var) == "Adults")       %>% pull(!!sym(measure_var))
    if (length(group_data) > 0 & length(adult_data) > 0) {
      tt <- t.test(group_data, adult_data, var.equal = FALSE)
      tibble(
        hemi             = unique(df$hemi),
        ROI              = unique(df$ROI),
        t_statistic      = unname(tt$statistic),
        p_value          = unname(tt$p.value),
        df               = unname(tt$parameter),
        mean_adolescents = mean(group_data, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_Adults      = mean(adult_data,  na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    } else NULL
  }

  res <- map_dfr(split_data, perform_t_test)

  # 3) Save (full + significant after BH-FDR)
  if (!missing(output_file_base) && !is.null(output_file_base)) {
    write_csv(res, paste0(output_file_base, "_all.csv"))
    res_sig <- res %>% mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% filter(p_adj < 0.05)
    write_csv(res_sig, paste0(output_file_base, "_sig.csv"))
  }
  res
}

# Run tests for FWHM using the same logic
tt_fwhm <- perform_and_save_t_tests(
  data            = df.plot,
  split_var       = c("hemi","ROI"),   # not used internally, kept for API parity
  group_var       = "group",
  measure_var     = "fwhm",
  output_file_base = file.path(output_directory, "t_FWHM")
)

# Build star labels from these exact tests (BH-FDR within all ROI×hemi)
p_to_stars <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(p)   ~ "",
  p < 0.001  ~ "***",
  p < 0.01   ~ "**",
  p < 0.05   ~ "*",
  TRUE       ~ ""
)

sig_tbl_fwhm <- tt_fwhm %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    stars = p_to_stars(p_value),
    lab   = ifelse(stars == "", "", paste0(stars)),
    x     = paste0("Adults.", hemi),          # exact discrete x labels in your violins
    y     = 39                                # sits under the 0–40 top limit
  ) %>%
  filter(lab != "")

# ------- 3) Figure code -------
p <- df.plot %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","zh")) %>%
  filter(!(hemi == "zh" & ROI %in% c("blank","blank1"))) %>%
  ggplot(.,
  aes(x = interaction(group, hemi, sep = "."),
      y = fwhm,
      fill = fill_key,
      alpha = stream)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean",
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
           width = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE, colour = NA) +  # mean bar, fill-only
  # --- Points: always Adults color for that ROI's category ---
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = point_col),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 1, alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "black", size = 1.5,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(y = "Total FWHM (°)") +
  facet_grid(~ ROI, drop = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.spacing = unit(6, "mm"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray96", size = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 0, 5.5, 5.5),
    axis.line.x  = element_line(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("lateraldorsal" = 0.5, "ventral" = .75)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_pal, limits = names(fill_pal), drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_identity() +                          # <- use hex colors as-is
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 40, 10), limits = c(0, 40))

# Optional: narrow 'blank' panels
rel_widths <- ifelse(levels(df.plot$ROI) %in% c("blank","blank1"), 0.45, 1)
# print(p + ggh4x::force_panelsizes(cols = unit(rel_widths, "null")))

p_lh <- p + 
  geom_text(
    data = sig_tbl_fwhm %>% filter(hemi == "lh") %>%
             mutate(ROI = factor(ROI, levels = levels(df.plot$ROI))),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    family = "Avenir", fontface = "bold", size = 8
  )

print(p_lh + ggh4x::force_panelsizes(cols = unit(rel_widths, "null")))


dev.off()

```

# Supplementary Figure 10. Total FWHM X ROI Size
```{r}
# ---- Filter, join, and compute significance ----
df_filtered <- df.cat_FWHM %>%
  left_join(df.ROIsize_cat_latdors, by = c("sub","hemi","group","ROI","category","stream","age")) %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"))

sig_rois_all <- df_filtered %>%
  filter(!ROI %in% c("blank","blank1")) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      d <- dplyr::filter(cur_data(), is.finite(fwhm), is.finite(totalvox))
      if (nrow(d) >= 3 && length(unique(d$totalvox)) > 1) {
        summary(lm(fwhm ~ totalvox, data = d))$coefficients[2,4]
      } else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(significant = !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05)

# ---- Apply ordering ----
df_sig_all <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(sig_rois_all, by = c("ROI","hemi")) %>%
  mutate(
    ROI   = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_all, ordered = TRUE),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("adolescents","Adults")),
    hemi  = factor(hemi,  levels = c("lh","rh"))
  )

# ---- Plot ----
png(file.path(output_directory, "S.Figure10_ROISize_FWHM_scatter_lm_ALL.png"),
    units = "in", width = 15, height = 4, res = 300)

ggplot(df_sig_all, aes(x = totalvox, y = fwhm, color = ROI, fill = ROI)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, na.rm = TRUE, aes(shape = group, alpha = group)) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = subset(df_sig_all, significant == TRUE & is.finite(totalvox) & is.finite(fwhm)),
    method = "lm", se = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(y = "Total FWHM (°)", x = "ROI Size (# Voxels)") +
  facet_grid(hemi ~ ROI) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "null"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray96", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, na.translate = FALSE, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal,  na.translate = FALSE, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("adolescents" = 0.4, "Adults" = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("adolescents" = 1, "Adults" = 16)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, 10), limits = c(0, 40)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 2000, 1000), limits = c(0, 2000),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25)))
# dev.off()

```

# ---- Filter, join, and compute significance ----
df_filtered <- df.cat_FWHM %>%
  left_join(df.ROIsize_cat_latdors, by = c("sub","hemi","group","ROI","category","stream","age")) %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"))

sig_rois_all <- df_filtered %>%
  filter(!ROI %in% c("blank","blank1")) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      d <- dplyr::filter(cur_data(), is.finite(fwhm), is.finite(meanT))
      if (nrow(d) >= 3 && length(unique(d$totalvox)) > 1) {
        summary(lm(fwhm ~ meanT, data = d))$coefficients[2,4]
      } else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(significant = !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05)

# ---- Apply ordering ----
df_sig_all <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(sig_rois_all, by = c("ROI","hemi")) %>%
  mutate(
    ROI   = factor(ROI, levels = roi_order_all, ordered = TRUE),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("adolescents","Adults")),
    hemi  = factor(hemi,  levels = c("lh","rh"))
  )

# ---- Plot ----
png(file.path(output_directory, "S.Figure10_catSelect_FWHM_scatter_lm_ALL.png"),
    units = "in", width = 15, height = 4, res = 300)

ggplot(df_sig_all, aes(x = meanT, y = fwhm, color = ROI, fill = ROI)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, na.rm = TRUE, aes(shape = group, alpha = group)) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = subset(df_sig_all, significant == TRUE & is.finite(meanT) & is.finite(fwhm)),
    method = "lm", se = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  labs(y = "Total FWHM (°)", x = "Mean T-Value") +

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, na.translate = FALSE, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal,  na.translate = FALSE, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("adolescents" = 0.4, "Adults" = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("adolescents" = 1, "Adults" = 16)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, 10), limits = c(0, 40)) +
